description: This file contains utility functions for handling task statuses, formatting task messages, and delivery policies within a task execution system.

methods.name: isTerminalTaskStatus
methods.description: Checks if a given task status is considered terminal (completed, failed, timed out, etc.).

methods.name: formatTaskTerminalMessage
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly message describing the terminal state of a task.

methods.name: formatTaskBlockedFollowupMessage
methods.description: Creates a follow-up message if a task was blocked and needs attention.

methods.name: formatTaskStateChangeMessage
methods.description: Formats a message indicating a change in task state, such as starting or progress update.

methods.name: shouldAutoDeliverTaskTerminalUpdate
methods.description: Determines if a terminal task update should be automatically delivered based on policies and status.

methods.name: shouldAutoDeliverTaskStateChange
methods.description: Checks if a task state change should be auto-delivered based on policies.

methods.name: shouldSuppressDuplicateTerminalDelivery
methods.description: Decides whether to suppress duplicate terminal delivery messages for tasks, especially for 'acp' runtime tasks.
